data_objects.name: mass_spectrometry_features
data_objects.meaning: Mass-spectrometry feature records with identifiers, mass-to-charge and retention-time coordinates, optional library identification text, an identification-level field, and an importance score.

variables.name: #featureID
variables.meaning: Text identifier for a detected feature, formatted from mass-to-charge and retention-time values.

variables.name: row ID
variables.meaning: Numeric row identifier assigned to the feature.

variables.name: row retention time
variables.meaning: Chromatographic retention-time coordinate of the feature; the time unit is not stated.

variables.name: LibraryID
variables.meaning: Optional text describing a spectral-library match or library identification.

variables.name: standard_indentification_level_1
variables.meaning: Field labeled for a level-one standard identification; its coding and criteria are not stated.

variables.name: _feature_id
variables.meaning: Second feature identifier using the same mass-to-charge and retention-time text pattern as #featureID.

variables.name: importance.score
variables.meaning: Numeric importance score assigned to the feature; its method and scale are not stated.

structure.description: Each row represents one detected mass-spectrometry feature positioned by mass-to-charge and retention time.
#featureID and _feature_id encode the feature's mass-to-charge and retention-time coordinates as underscore-separated text.

uncertainties: The retention-time unit, instrument context, importance-score definition, and identification-level codebook are not supplied.
The relationship between row ID and the two feature-ID columns is not documented beyond their visible formats.
annotation_notes: Semantics are limited to the column labels and field encodings visible in train.csv.
